## 🚀 Featured Enterprise Projects

### 1. 🛒 [E-Commerce Customer Segmentation Engine](https://github.com)
An unsupervised machine learning pipeline designed to clean, transform, and segment raw, noisy behavioral transaction streams originating from a multi-thousand-row Excel dataset.
*   **Data Engineering:** Cleansed 541k+ messy operational rows down to a pristine sandbox of 406k observations by isolating anonymous entries and cancelled transactions.
*   **Feature Architecture:** Developed individual customer Recency, Frequency, and Monetary (RFM) vectors.
*   **Machine Learning:** Tamed extreme transaction "whales" using Log-10 feature scaling and optimized a non-parametric K-Means Clustering network to map out K=3 definitive strategic marketing tiers.

### 2. 🏡 [Real Estate Analytics & Predictive Engine](https://github.com)
A supervised machine learning forecasting pipeline built to ingest, audit, and project overall macro property values over a 72-year chronological time-series horizon.
*   **Data Pipeline:** Engineered a dynamic REST-API ingestion layer streaming raw transaction logs directly over the web.
*   **Statistical Auditing:** Conducted an Independent Two-Sample T-Test ($p = 0.1797$) up to a calculated May 2015 data cutoff, exposing a hidden 10-year flatline zero gap in secondary tracking fields that had severely corrupted initial statistical reads.
*   **Ensemble Modeling:** Trained a Random Forest Regressor on unlocked historical data up to May 2025, capturing non-linear market shocks to score an elite **0.9993 R² explanatory power** and a Mean Absolute Error of **£2,460.54**.
